“Illya? What's wrong? Why are you staring off into space? A moment ago, you were beside yourself with excitement about staying at Shirou's house.”

“…I don't know. I wasn't excited at all.”

“Illya? Why are you spaced out? You were so happy we were going to stay at Shirou’s house.”
“…That’s not true. I was never happy.”

pages.en:
Her voice is listless.

Illya hangs her head and stares fixedly at the floor of the hall.

…As though a step only a few centimeters high were a towering wall.
pages.mirrorMoon:
A weak voice.
Illya hangs her head and stares at the floor.
…As if saying the small step up is a towering wall.

The listlessness of a moment ago vanishes. Illya turns suddenly and glares at Sakura.

pages.en:
“Hm? Sakura's room is the guest room in the detached wing.”

“I see. Then Rin can have the detached wing to herself. Anywhere else is fine for me.”

“Really? Then you can have the tatami room.”

Apparently they have already grown close enough to call each other Rin and Illya. Tohsaka and Illya make the exchange with perfect ease.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…? Um, Sakura’s sleeping in the guest room in the outbuilding.”
“I see. Then you can go to the outbuilding by yourself, Rin. I don’t care where I am, as long as it’s not in the outbuilding.”
“Is that so? Then I guess you can have the Japanese-style room.”
They’re carrying on a relaxed conversation, and it sounds like they’re close enough now to call each other by name.
